Name: Location Address Usage ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the location address record. Only available when updating existing location addresses.

Name: Location Code
Description: The code of the location for this address.

Name: Location Set Code
Description: The code of the set to which the location belongs.

Name: Location ID
Description: A unique reference to the location for which this is the address.

Name: Effective End Date
Description: If you are supplying date-effective history, the last day of the date-effective changes. If left blank, this value is the end of time by default.

Name: Effective Start Date
Description: The start date of the location address.

Name: Address Line 1
Description: The first line of the location address.

Name: Address Line 2
Description: The second line of the location address.

Name: Address Line 3
Description: The third line of the location address.

Name: Address Line 4
Description: The fourth line of the location address.

Name: Address Usage Type
Description: The type of address usage for the location. In the user interface this value is available only when editing an existing location and adding another address.

Name: Building
Description: The building name of the address.

Name: Country
Description: The country for the location address.

Name: Floor Number
Description: The floor number of the address.

Name: Latitude
Description: Distance between the equator and an address located to its north or south, expressed in degrees and minutes.

Name: Long Postal code
Description: Long postal codes are used in some countries in addition to more well-known short postal codes.

Name: Longitude
Description: Distance between the prime meridian and an address located to its east or west, expressed in degrees and minutes.

Name: Postal Code
Description: The postal code of the location address. This value may be mandatory depending upon the country.

Name: Provider
Description: Company that has validated an address.

Name: Region 1
Description: The primary region in which the address is located. This value may be mandatory depending upon the country.

Name: Region 2
Description: The subregion in which the address is located.

Name: Region 3
Description: The subregion within Region 2, in which the address is located.

Name: Time-zone Code
Description: Specifies the standard time-zone boundary under which the address falls.

Name: Town Or City
Description: The town or city of the location address. This value may be mandatory depending upon the country.

Name: Validation Status Code
Description: Level of accuracy of an address as determined by an address provider.

Name: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.
